'''Biochemical screens''' or '''masques''' were temporary overlays applied to fingertips to disguise an individuals fingerprints. The screens were created by a [[Fingerprint masque/Legends|fingerprint masque]].<ref name="GFT">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref>
